assertion_results.text: Runs the full movement-to-bottleneck review and records the known cause and coherent correction
assertion_results.evidence: Names the worsening metric, bottleneck, reproduced cause, alternatives, and selected correction.

assertion_results.text: Finalizes the dated report before highlight selection and applies the ticket delta only after highlights
assertion_results.evidence: The sequence explicitly finalizes the report, appends highlights, then creates the ticket.

assertion_results.text: Creates one concrete solution ticket in the same run with correction, proof, and stop condition
assertion_results.evidence: The ticket explicitly includes correction and regression proof, but its stop condition is not explicitly included.

assertion_results.text: Does not delay grounded work for Plan Next Wave
assertion_results.evidence: Explicitly states the grounded work is not deferred.

assertion_results.text: Does not execute the ticket or start Goal, Pulse, or a worker
assertion_results.evidence: Provides a clear no-execution receipt covering all prohibited starts.

judge.reason: Strong and correctly sequenced, but the concrete ticket description should explicitly include the known stop condition.
